title: Other Ways to Say "Furthermore" #shorts
description:
Other ways to say "furthermore" in English. Here are five:
• Moreover. (The plan is cheap. Moreover, it is fast.)
• Equally important. (Equally important, the course is free.)
• Not only that. (Not only that, the app works offline.)
• What's more. (What's more, the results were clear.)
• Beyond that. (Beyond that, the method saves time.)

Want more words for furthermore? Find them on anotherwordfor.net
